meta.title: Grade AI — AI Exam Analysis Platform
meta.description: Upload exam results, get instant analysis, and ask AI about your school's performance.

home.title: Understand your school's exam results in minutes, not days
home.subtitle: Upload an Excel sheet of results and Grade AI validates it, calculates every statistic, and writes a clear report — in English, Somali, or Arabic.
home.featuresTitle: Everything a school needs from exam results

excel.title: Excel upload
excel.description: Upload .xlsx, .xls, or .csv results. Every row is validated before anything is saved — marks are never silently changed.

analysis.title: Automatic analysis
analysis.description: Totals, averages, ranks, pass rates, and strongest/weakest subjects — calculated by the database, not guessed by AI.

aiReports.title: AI-written reports
aiReports.description: Executive summaries, recommendations, and insights generated from your verified data, downloadable as PDF.

assistant.title: AI assistant
assistant.description: Ask "who are the top 10 students?" or "generate a report for Ahmed Ali" and get an answer grounded in your school's real data.

languages.title: English, Somali, Arabic
languages.description: Every report and the entire interface works in all three languages, with full right-to-left support for Arabic.

security.title: Your data stays yours
security.description: Row-level security ensures one school can never see another school's students, exams, or reports.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Start analyzing your school's exam results in minutes.

fileErrors.no_rows: The file doesn't contain any data rows.

fileErrors.ai_analysis_failed: We couldn't make sense of this file's contents. Double-check it has student names and marks, then try again.
fileErrors.rows_omitted: The analysis didn't come back with all of your students — this can happen on very large files. Please try again, or split the file into smaller batches.
